summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting an amendment to an existing securities purchase agreement, increasing the available capacity for future convertible promissory notes to $10 million, and disclosed the abrupt resignation of chairman Amitay Weiss effective April 26, 2026 (no disagreement cited), along with related board and committee appointments. The convertible note program involves up to $10 million aggregate principal with quarterly issuance mechanics, but no specific new issuance, pricing, or premium details are provided. No deal terms are stated; the filing covers routine financing capacity augmentation and voluntary board changes. This is a non-US (Canadian) issuer filing a foreign private issuer report.
